sites.name: RICHMOND ST / CHILVER RD
sites.note: The official photograph shows a marked crossing, while four nearby OSM nodes are tagged unmarked/no. Way 1395959062 forms a closed loop around multiple road arms. Identify the photographed arm and split the way if appropriate; do not retag the entire loop. The photograph date is unknown.

sites.name: BANWELL RD / MULBERRY DR
sites.note: The official photograph shows a pedestrian crossover with amber warning flashers; nearby OSM data uses crossing=traffic_signals. Verify whether there are actual pedestrian red/green signals. A push button or amber flasher alone does not establish a signal-controlled crossing.

sites.name: RHODES DR / ELECTRICITY DR
sites.note: An official site photograph shows a marked pedestrian crossover. Screening found only an unmarked crossing node about 62 metres away, outside the target road. Verify the exact crossing position and whether an existing footway already represents it without crossing tags.

sites.name: MATCHETT RD / TITCOMBE RD
sites.note: The City lists a pedestrian crossover here. No highway=crossing node was found within 85 metres of the review anchor, and a local main-API map was retrieved. Footways, exact location and current construction status still need review.

sites.name: LITTLE RIVER BLVD / CORA GREENWOOD DR
sites.note: The City lists a pedestrian crossover, while nearby OSM crossing nodes are tagged unmarked. Verify the same road arm and the installation date before proposing a tag change.

sites.name: PILLETTE RD / MILLOY ST
sites.note: The City lists a pedestrian crossover, while nearby nodes are tagged unmarked. This is an attribute-review candidate: verify each road arm individually rather than marking the whole intersection.

sites.name: City of Windsor Aquatic Centre
sites.note: Municipal GIS and the current City facility page both list charging facilities. The local OSM main-API map, including nodes, ways and relations, did not contain amenity=charging_station at the site. This is a candidate for a small pilot, subject to exact coordinates, station grouping, current conditions and source-licence review. The two City publications are one publisher, not independent field observations.
